thread.first_post_html:
The truck has been through many different set ups since I have bought it new and never made a thread about it so its about time

here it is stock besides front tint



after 7000k I got bored of it so I put a 3 BL on



Added some 17x8 Weld Mountain Crusher rims with 285 BFG ATs, ford keys and 4 rear blocks



Got bored of that so I put the SuperLift lift in with 5.5 rear blocks



Put some 37 BFG MTs on along with 4.56 gears and a tru trac



Did a shackle flip, AAL and cranked abit





Decided it was time to go bigger so cranked more and added a 2" block



Towered the 37"s so it was time for 39.5 Iroks, some 5.13 gears, long tube headers, mild tune, magnaflow muffler with dumps



Got tired of waiting for my 10bolt to blow so swapped in a 14FF,5.38 gears, Air Locker, disk brakes, zero rate and needed some cheap rims that I didnt have to clean so I got my Pro Comp 17x9 rims





Ran that setup for a couple years and kept getting harrased by the cops and got pulled off the road twice for being to big so I was forced to go smaller so I put some 36" Iroks on with some chevy tails, this was legal height



couldnt stand having it so low so I cranked abit, added 2" block with zero rate and some tow mirrors, this is how it sits now but I have since plasti dipped the chrome on the front grill and still have to do the front and back bumpers.
I figured if I couldnt be on 40"s anymore I may aswell make it faster so I added a TSP220 cam, circle D 3200 stall, TBSS intake, BB Auto Cal tune, I added a cat along with a Bullet/Magnaflow to quiet it down abit



I also added some air bags that I can raise the truck 4" with and crank the front for those days when I want to jack it up to tower over other trucks



Got bored with the TSP cam so I now have a PatG speced/EPS ground 223 226, 610 605 110+4 cam, TEA .660 dual springs with titanium retainers. I also have a Circle D 36-3700 stall and nitrous kit to install when I have time. I will be spraying a 150 shot.
I am sure I am forget alot of stuff over the years but that is basically what it was and what it is as of right now.
I have a Ford HP D60 for the front that I will install when I scrap up the funds to do my SAS. Not to sure if I am gonna jack it up on 40"s again and make it legal with some wide rims and big flares or keep it on 36-37"s with a wider rim.
I will keep updating as I keep adding

rewrite.rewritten_title: Truck Through Its Stages: A Journey from Stock to Beast
rewrite.summary: This thread chronicles the transformation of a truck through various modifications, including suspension lifts, tire changes, and engine upgrades. The journey highlights the owner's progression in customization over several years.
rewrite.rewritten_article_markdown:
This truck has undergone many changes since its purchase. Initially, it was just a stock vehicle with front tint (Post ID: 255). 

Over time, the owner installed a 3-inch lift (Post ID: 255) and added 17x8 Weld Mountain Crusher rims with BFG ATs (Post ID: 255). After getting bored of this setup, they added a SuperLift lift with 5.5 rear blocks (Post ID: 255), followed by 37-inch BFG MT tires and 4.56 gears along with a Tru-Trac differential (Post ID: 255).

Further modifications included a shackle flip, AAL, and additional tuning (Post ID: 255). The owner then added a 2-inch block to increase clearance (Post ID: 255), leading to the installation of 39.5-inch IROK tires with 5.13 gears, long tube headers, a mild tune, and a Magnaflow muffler with dumps (Post ID: 255).

Due to legal issues, the truck was reduced in height by installing 36-inch IROK tires with Chevy tails for legality (Post ID: 255). The owner then focused on making it faster, adding a TSP220 cam, Circle D 3200 stall, TBSS intake, BB Auto Cal tune, and cat along with Magnaflow muffler to reduce noise (Post ID: 255).

Air bags were installed to raise the truck by 4 inches for special occasions (Post ID: 255). Currently, the owner has a PatG spec'd/EPS ground 223/226 camshaft with TEA .660 dual springs and titanium retainers. They also have a Circle D 36-3700 stall and nitrous system ready for installation (Post ID: 255).

Future plans include adding a Ford HP D60 front end when funds are available (Post ID: 255). The owner is undecided whether to return the truck to 40-inch tires or keep it on 36-37 inches with wider rims and flares (Post ID: 255).

The truck was also plasti-dipped for a chrome look, but some areas still need attention (Post ID: 255).

post_rewrites.rewritten_content:
Since purchasing the truck new, I've gone through multiple setups. Initially, it had stock tires until I installed 3 BL after 7000k. I later added 17x8 Weld Mountain Crusher rims with 285 BFG ATs and Ford keys, along with 4 rear blocks.

After getting bored of that setup, I added a SuperLift lift and 5.5 rear blocks, switching to 37 BFG MTs, 4.56 gears, and a Tru-Trac. I performed a shackle flip, AAL, and dialed in the suspension.

Deciding to go bigger, I upgraded to 2" blocks for a taller stance, installed 39.5 Iroks, 5.13 gears, long tube headers, a mild tune, and a Magnaflow muffler with dumps. Due to frequent police harassment, I downgraded to 36" Iroks with Chevy tails for legality.

To improve ride height, I added 2" blocks with zero rate and tow mirrors. Currently, the truck runs on Pro Comp 17x9 rims. Chrome plasti-dip has been applied to the front grill, but not yet to the bumpers.

Frustrated by the low stance, I upgraded to a TSP220 cam, Circle D 3200 stall, TBSS intake, BB Auto Cal tune, and added a cat along with Bullet/Magnaflow mufflers. Air bags allow for an additional 4" lift when needed.

Recently, I swapped in a PatG spec'd/EPS ground 223/226 cam, TEA .660 dual springs with titanium retainers. A Circle D 36-3700 stall and nitrous kit are ready to be installed once funds permit.

Currently using an HP D60 for the front end, I plan to install SAS when funds allow. Future plans include either going back to 40" tires with wide rims and flares or staying on 36-37"s with wider rims. Updates will be shared as new modifications are made.

Here are some additional images. Mine is a truck with a D60 in the bed, along with various items. My brother’s truck features 325 Terra Grapplers, 3-inch BL suspension, Ford keys, and 4-inch lift blocks.
The truck appears excellent. I wish I could achieve the same result for my own truck.
I hope I can achieve that someday.
Thank you everyone!

Thank you everyone. I enjoyed raising the vehicle, but I find it even more fun with the increased speed and smaller tires.

I recently acquired a 6L engine and plan to install L92 heads along with a custom-cammed setup. My goal is to achieve 400-450 rwhp and consider adding power through a later upgrade.
I love this truck.
